item.title: Azure and .NET Website Modernization: Umbraco, Security, Accessibility and Technical Proposal Support (US Citizens Only)
item.description: 8-15 USD/hr | We ara seeking experienced freelancers or a qualified technical team to support a proposal for a multi-website hosting, maintenance and modernization project. The initial engagement covers technical planning, solution architecture, prototype wireframes and a client demonstration presentation. Implementation and ongoing support may follow, subject to project award and a separate agreement. The project involves public-facing websites, an Umbraco-based knowledge portal, static content, document libraries, event archives and video hosting. The proposed solution must address secure Azure hosting, CMS upgrades, accessible design, advanced search, content management, operational reliability and federal security requirements. Scope of Work Review the supplied project requirements and help develop a complete technical proposal with a clear implementation approach, architecture diagrams, staffing plan, effort estimates, delivery milestones, risks and requirements traceability. Define the Azure hosting architecture, including separate staging and production environments, infrastructure as code using Bicep, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, security controls and a migration plan with validation and rollback procedures. Plan Umbraco modernization from existing v8 or v13 installations to an appropriate supported version. Assess content migration, custom integrations, back-office extensions, ASP.NET Core compatibility and editor workflows. Develop prototype wireframes and presentation materials demonstrating responsive navigation, searchable document libraries, metadata filtering, glossary and citation interactions, bookmarks, saved searches and content review workflows. Address Section 508 accessibility, WCAG conformance, USWDS design, automated and manual testing, accessible PDFs, security assessment evidence and Google Analytics reporting. Required Skills and Certifications I am looking for the following qualifications across the proposed team. Individual specialists may apply for their area of expertise; one person is not expected to hold every certification. Solutions Architect / Technical Lead: 10+ years of experience; strong .NET and Azure architecture skills; Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert; experience supporting federal cloud authorization. Senior Umbraco / .NET Developer: Umbraco certification; 6+ years of ASP.NET Core experience; demonstrated Umbraco upgrades or migrations from v8 and v13. Azure / DevSecOps Engineer: Azure certifications covering AZ-104 and AZ-305; Bicep expertise; 5+ years of regulated hosting experience. Accessibility Specialist: DHS Trusted Tester certification; 5+ years of accessibility testing and remediation experience, including Section 508 and accessibility conformance reporting. Information Security Specialist: CISSP or CISM; hands-on NIST SP 800-53 assessment experience; familiarity with RMF, authorization documentation and continuous monitoring. UX/UI Designer: Federal USWDS project experience and a relevant portfolio. QA / Test Engineer: ISTQB certification or equivalent qualification; practical Playwright experience. Analytics Specialist: Google Analytics certification and experience with GA4 configuration, reporting and website performance measurement.

item.title: Cargo Pickup CRM & Invoicing
item.description:
250-750 USD | I need a streamlined CRM and invoicing system that supports our door-to-door cargo service from the moment a booking is taken to the final proof-of-delivery.
Here’s how the flow should work:
• Admin staff create each booking with the customer’s basic details, pickup address, rough item description (e.g., “2 suitcases, 3 boxes, electricals”), and an estimated total weight. They must also be able to attach collection and extra charges, raise invoices, record payments, and assign the job to a driver.
• Drivers log in, see only the collections assigned to them, and update the status as they go. While on site they add or edit receiver details, list every item type with its exact weight, note the number of pieces, snap photos of what they collected, and mark whether payment was by card, cash, or bank transfer. Once delivered, they confirm completion and upload a final proof-of-delivery photo.
• Back in the office, the admin team track delivery status in real time, review all driver-submitted photos, generate or adjust invoices, and pull basic reports (daily pickups, outstanding payments, weight summaries, etc.).
Acceptance criteria – Clean, responsive interface with separate permission levels for admin staff and drivers – Booking form that stores estimated weights yet lets drivers overwrite with actuals – Secure image upload for collection and proof-of-delivery photos – Automatic invoice generation that reflects collection fees, extra charges, and recorded payment method – Status timeline visible to both admin and driver (“Booked → Assigned → Collected → In Transit → Delivered”) – Exportable reports (CSV or PDF) for deliveries, payments, and charges
I am open to your preferred tech stack as long as the final system is web-based, fast, and easy for non-technical staff to maintain. Please outline your proposed approach, tools, and a realistic timeline in your bid.
either build a new system or offer me a system already build just need editing what ever is cost-effective and reliable

item.title: Mailchimp New Email Builder Specialist Needed
item.description:
30-250 USD | Fixed Amount: $55
We are looking for an experienced Mailchimp Specialist with proven expertise in Mailchimp's New Email Builder and native editable content blocks. The freelancer must have hands-on experience personally building complete, fully editable email templates using Mailchimp's New Email Builder, not just general email development or custom HTML.
We have five existing email templates in Mail chimp that need to be audited, corrected to ensure they are fully editable and reusable by our team. No HTML, no coding, and no entire email sections converted into static JPG or PNG images. Before the project is awarded, shortlisted freelancers must demonstrate their ability to build and edit a complete email template directly inside Mailchimp's New Email Builder using native content blocks.
The demonstration must show the actual Mailchimp editing interface, including how to edit text, replace images, modify buttons and links, and add, delete, duplicate, and rearrange content sections.
A finished design, screenshot, or portfolio image alone will not be accepted as proof of technical experience.
The project also includes fully editable video integration using Mailchimp's native Video Content Block, with the expertise to configure and manage video content correctly for email campaigns. Previous hands-on experience with Mailchimp's native Video Content Block is required. The freelancer must be able to demonstrate how to replace the video thumbnail and independently update its destination URL.
Additionally, the freelancer must provide a customized PDF user manual with actual screenshots, clear step-by-step instructions, and video tutorials demonstrating how to manage and edit each template section. The training materials must show our team how to use, manage, customize, duplicate, and reuse the templates to create independently, all five templates for future different marketing campaigns, without requiring coding or technical assistance. Our goal is to have a complete, user-friendly Mailchimp system that allows our team to independently manage, customize, duplicate, and reuse all five templates for future campaigns.
A separate document will be deliver after award. It contains the complete list of tasks, technical requirements and deliverables.
Our deadline is 10 calendar days, including Saturdays and excluding Sundays, from the project award date. Is required daily updates follow Eastern Time (ET). We expect prompt communication, regular progress updates, and strict adherence to the agreed deadline.
All deliverables, including the five templates, PDF manual, video tutorials, must be completed within this period. The freelancer must demonstrate the ability to create these training materials based on the actual completed templates, not generic Mailchimp instructions.
Payment will be released after all deliverables are completed, tested, reviewed, and approved. Please note, this is an urgent project and failure to deliver before or on 10 days after awarded the project there will be a 15% penalty to deduct from the full payment of the project.
Please apply only if you can meet the complete project requirements.

item.title: Secure Multi-Tenant AI Video Editing, Distribution, and Project Manager Platform
item.description:
250-750 USD | Title: Senior engineer (Claude Code + security) to turn our AI video-editing factory into a secure, multi-client product
About us We’re a media distribution brand that makes a lot of short vertical video ads for TikTok and Instagram. Over the last few months we built an in-house AI “creative factory” with Claude Code. It does the work of a video editor: it picks up tasks from our project board and edits the raw creator footage into a finished ad. A human reviews and approves, and only then is the final file rendered and delivered.
It works, but it’s a prototype: it runs on one Mac, the keys sit in a .env file, and it’s built for one company. We want an engineer to make it professional, secure and repeatable so it can run for several businesses, each with its own brand, accounts and data.
What exists today
Pipeline: Node 22 server with SQLite. Stations are Intake → Edit → QA → Human review → Render → Delivery. A live “factory floor” web UI shows the jobs moving between stations. Workers: Python plus ffmpeg. Transcription (ElevenLabs Scribe), an assembly cut (best take of each line, retakes and dead air removed), and an LLM-planned main edit (captions, overlays, product shots, zooms) through OpenRouter (Claude, plus Gemini as a QA judge). Editor: each ad is an editable timeline project in an open-source web video editor (a customised OpenFilm Studio). The reviewer can open each timeline, change it and approve it. Integrations: the Asana API (task pickup, custom fields), the Frame.io V4 API (delivery) and Google Drive (footage). Guardrails: Claude Code hooks, subagents and skills, plus spend caps per day and per job.
What we want built
A cloud deployment. Everything runs on a server: footage never touches a laptop, and nothing is rendered until a human approves. A desktop workstation app for Mac. It’s a thin client: several jobs open at once, each in its own timeline window, all streamed from the cloud. Multi-tenancy. Each business gets its own isolated workspace: data, footage, brand kit, API connections, spend limits and users. Repeatable onboarding. Adding a new business should be config, not code: connect Asana, Drive and Frame.io, upload brand assets, set the rules. Production quality: CI, tests, monitoring, logs, backups and documentation.
Must-haves
Strong, hands-on Claude Code experience: CLAUDE.md, subagents, skills, hooks, MCP servers, and ideally the Claude Agent SDK and headless runs. Please show real examples. Cybersecurity, applied. We will test you on: secrets management and least-privilege service accounts tenant isolation (one client can never see another client’s footage or keys) zero-trust access to internal tools (no exposed admin ports) webhook signature checks prompt-injection defence: our agents read task text, scripts and comments, which are untrusted input supply-chain hygiene (pinned dependencies) and audit logs Node.js and Python in production, Linux servers, ffmpeg or other media-pipeline experience. Clear written English and async communication.
Nice to have
Swift or desktop-app experience (Tauri or native macOS) Experience with video at scale (proxies, streaming, GPU or headless rendering) Hetzner, Modal, AWS, or Cloudflare (Access/Tunnel) SOC 2-style thinking: access reviews, data retention, incident response
How to apply (answers without these will be skipped)
Start your bid with the word “VSRL”. Describe a Claude Code hook, subagent or MCP server you’ve built, and what it did. In 3–5 sentences: how would you stop an AI agent from following instructions hidden in a client’s task description? How would you isolate tenants’ files and API keys on a shared server? Links to relevant work (GitHub, case studies).
Budget: $300 / Month (negotiable) · Longterm job - at least for the next 6 months. We’ll share the full architecture under an NDA after an interview. Contract under USA cybersecurity and copyright laws.
